description: Puts a poster for the user's product on the wall. Requires the user's API key. The user must have asked for this and approved the title, description, website and image: call it first with dry_run=true, show the user the result, and only then publish. The poster image is placed automatically on a free spot. Free posters stay for 30 days.

alternatives.description: Other products people use for the same job, comma separated. Optional. Ask the user; do not invent it.

audience.description: Who the product is for, in the maker's words. Optional. Ask the user; do not invent it.

creator_name.description: Maker name shown on the poster page. Optional.

description.description: What the product does, in plain words.

dry_run.description: Check everything and report what would be published, without publishing.

faq.description: Up to 3 common questions with the user's own answers. Optional. Never invent answers.

image_base64.description: The poster image itself, base64-encoded (a data: URL also works). Optional.

image_url.description: Public https link to the poster image (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB, ratio between 1:2 and 2:1). Optional.

language.description: Two-letter language code of the text, such as en. Optional.

name: publish_product
title: Put a product on the wall
